title: Former NFL player Chris Payton-Jones, 30, dead in a Florida car crash: ‘A great player but even better person’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former NFL player Chris Payton-Jones, 30, dead in a Florida car crash: ‘A great player but even better person’
sources.description: Payton-Jones signed with the Lions, Titans, Vikings and Raiders, playing in 29 games over six seasons in the league. He recorded 48 tackles and seven passes defended in the NFL.
